skill.name: gemini-image
skill.description: Generate images from text prompts or image URLs through a configured third-party image API.
skill.summary: A Chinese-language workflow for text-to-image and image-to-image requests.
skill.author: Ceeon

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting or ordinary local installation steps and are false positives. The skill does make a real curl request with a bearer API key to an undisclosed third-party image endpoint, and its README routes key acquisition through an affiliate URL on a different domain. Users should review the provider and avoid sending sensitive prompts or images.

remediation.issue: The skill sends prompts and image URLs to a third-party endpoint that is not identified in the skill description.
remediation.suggestion: Name the API provider, link its privacy policy and terms, and obtain user confirmation before transmitting prompts or image references.

remediation.issue: The API-key registration link contains an affiliate parameter and differs from the API host.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the affiliate link or disclose the relationship clearly, and direct users to the API provider's official key-management page.

remediation.issue: The example places an API key in a local Markdown secret file.
remediation.suggestion: Document restrictive file permissions and prefer a secure environment-variable or credential-store integration where available.

content.user_title: Generate Images From Prompts and References
content.value_statement: Creating images requires structured prompts, an API key, and an image endpoint. This skill provides a short Chinese-language workflow for text-to-image and image-to-image requests.
actual_capabilities: Reads an API key from a local configuration file.
Builds text-to-image prompts with a model, size, and image count.
Accepts an image URL with a descriptive prompt for image-to-image generation.
Accepts multiple image URLs as visual references.
Posts an image-generation request to the configured API endpoint.
Returns the first image URL from the API response.
limitations: It depends on a third-party API account and valid API key.
It does not include the referenced upload or Chinese-text guidance files in this package.
It does not validate image URL ownership, safety, or accessibility.
It does not document API pricing, privacy, retention, or provider terms.

use_cases.title: Create concept images
use_cases.description: Turn a concise visual brief into an image-generation request with a chosen aspect ratio.

use_cases.title: Produce marketing variations
use_cases.description: Generate several visual directions from product copy or campaign descriptions.

use_cases.title: Explore image references
use_cases.description: Use one or more hosted reference images to request a related visual style.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a simple image
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an image of a small orange cat sleeping beside a window.

prompt_templates.title: Set an aspect ratio
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 16:9 mountain landscape at sunrise. Use a calm watercolor style.

prompt_templates.title: Use one reference image
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this image URL as a reference, create a similar poster with a blue and gold color palette: [image URL].

prompt_templates.title: Combine references
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these two image URLs as references. Combine the lighting from the first with the composition from the second: [URL 1] [URL 2].

output_examples.input: Generate a square illustration of a library at night.
output_examples.output: A returned image URL for a square night-library illustration.

output_examples.input: Create a wide sunset landscape in a watercolor style.
output: A returned image URL for the generated watercolor landscape.

best_practices: Review the third-party provider's privacy terms before using the skill.
Use only images and prompts that you are authorized to share.
Store the API key with restricted local file permissions and rotate it if exposed.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential images, personal data, or proprietary prompts without provider approval.
Do not treat placeholder image URLs as working source images.
Do not assume the skill uses an official Gemini endpoint or service.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It formats image-generation requests for text prompts and image references.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow reads an API key from a local secret file.

faq.question: Which service receives the request?
faq.answer: The documented curl command sends requests to api.apicore.ai.

faq.question: Can I use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill accepts one or more image URLs with a description.

faq.question: Does the package include image upload support?
faq.answer: No. The skill references an upload guide that is not present in this package.

faq.question: Should I send sensitive content?
faq.answer: No. Review the provider's privacy terms and avoid sharing sensitive prompts, images, or credentials.
